title: How to answer "tell me about yourself" when doing a career switch
description:
What is the first interview question that you'll get when applying for a new job? "Tell me about yourself." But how do you answer this question when you're doing a career switch or job change?

If you're doing a career transition or switch, this is the video for you. In this video, you will learn how to answer the most common interview question and give interviewers the confidence to hire you.

Career changes are our specialty and we get this question a lot from our clients. We've talked with the top recruiters from Fortune 500 companies to understand what they were looking when hiring someone who doesn't have the "perfect" profile.

3 key points to remember:

# 1: Build trust by admitting that you aren't the typical candidate they hire
#2: Research the job to understand the day-to-day responsibilities
#3: Give the interviewer confidence that you can do the job by showing your transferable skills
